title: Your story should be handled with care
intro: A plain-language privacy note for visitors who contact Ancestral Path.

sections.heading: Messages
sections.body: WhatsApp messages are handled through WhatsApp and are visible to the people participating in the conversation.

sections.heading: Information
sections.body: Share only what is necessary for your question. Do not send sensitive medical, financial, or legal records.

sections.heading: Your choice
sections.body: You can ask us to stop a conversation at any time.
